notes: Audit Remediation: Qdrant local embedded mode uses SQLite exact brute-force search. HNSW parameters (M, ef_construct, ef_search) have no effect in local mode. This benchmark characterizes exact retrieval fidelity against NumPy BLAS across all 114 queries.

resource_footprint.memory_measurement_qualification: tracemalloc tracks Python-allocated heap memory (including NumPy arrays in recent versions); it misses SQLite and other native allocations.

regime_a_within_paper.latency_explanation: Likely includes Python-side payload filtering overhead; not profiled.

regime_b_global_corpus.latency_explanation: Likely dominated by in-process Python/NumPy scan; not profiled.
